name: Claire
text: Whenever you feel like criticizing anyone, he told me, just remember that all the people in this world haven't had the advantages that you've had. He didn't say any more, but we've always been unusually communicative in a reserved way, and I understood that he meant a great deal more than that.
source: LibriVox Public Domain: The Great Gatsby (1925), Ch. 1, read by Kara Shallenberg (greatgatsby_2101_librivox)
author: haru-kit
